decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range has low carrying costs in the catalogue, and nothing indicates its value has failed, so the option stays open.
The multi-model handle family fits existing production and project distribution, so keeping it remains cheap while it serves ongoing project demand.
As a single design among many handle options it is more expendable, but there is no evidence of failure and maintenance costs are minimal, so dropping it now would be premature.
This single design variant costs little to maintain, and without negative signals the option is better kept than abandoned.
The flagship electronic access system is the firm's strategic growth option toward digital building organization, so continued commitment is justified rather than abandonment.
